description: This file defines the YieldNotReadyNodeVisitor class used internally in Twig to manage node visiting logic related to yield readiness, including handling attributes and deprecation warnings.

classes.name: YieldNotReadyNodeVisitor
classes.description: A final class implementing NodeVisitorInterface to handle visiting nodes in Twig, specifically managing 'yield' readiness attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the visitor with a boolean indicating whether 'yield' should be used.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Processes a node when entering it during traversal, checking for 'YieldReady' attribute and throwing or warning if conditions are not met.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Handles logic when leaving a node; in this case, it simply returns the node.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this visitor, set to 255.
